# Ahsan Khan

Open to relocation for a full-time senior engineering role, remote roles across US/EU/GCC/APAC time zones, and freelance or contract projects.

Portfolio: https://ahsankhaan.vercel.app

## Availability

- Full-time, open to relocating internationally (fintech, food-tech, delivery/marketplace platforms)

- Freelance / agency: AI agents and Claude Code pipelines, n8n workflow automation, agentic SEO, marketing content strategy, Next.js and Astro websites, programmatic SEO tool sites, admin portals, full-stack MVPs and backend architecture

## Core skills

React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Laravel, REST APIs, MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, AWS, Cloudflare, Hetzner VPS, BullMQ, Redis, Git, GitHub Actions CI/CD, PCI DSS, OWASP Top 10. Agentic AI: Claude Code agents, skills and hooks; OpenAI Codex and Gemini CLI agent definitions.

- Architected frontends serving 100K+ users (Nayapay admin, business and public portals)

- Built a merchant onboarding automation engine, cutting onboarding from 5 days to under 24 hours
- Notification segmentation system reaching 2M+ users
- 3 consecutive security audits with zero critical findings (PCI DSS / OWASP Top 10)
